usage: The word '焗' (guk6) is a verb meaning 'to bake' or 'to cook using dry heat in an oven'.
You can use '焗' before a food noun to describe how the dish is prepared, e.g., 焗飯 (baked rice).
'焗' is often used in menus and recipes to indicate baked dishes.
It is commonly combined with other ingredients like cheese, rice or seafood to name baked dishes.
When saying something is baked, just put '焗' before the main food item.
